title: Names a rename refuses
summary: Pressing rename on an operator, a symbol or a macro of the system headers, a macro the compile command defines, a name its instantiations resolve to several symbols or the parenthesis of a constructor call says why it cannot be renamed; off any name, nothing happens

prepare_rename.error: `operator+` is named by the language, not by an identifier
no name of `Gauge` is written here
the name here resolves to `Point::x` and `Size::x`; rename them to one name in one list of renames, or one of them from its declaration
`printf` is declared in a system header
the compile command or the compiler defines `FROM_BUILD`, which a rename cannot change
`EOF` is defined in a system header
